title: AI model prices cut in half, EU labelling rules, a faster open-source database

segments.text: Good morning, and welcome to Tech On The Go, your five minute tech catch-up.

segments.headline: Cloud provider cuts AI model prices by almost half
segments.text: Here is what matters today. A major cloud provider cut the price of its fastest AI models by almost half, which could make advanced assistants affordable for much smaller teams.

segments.headline: Europe publishes rules for labelling machine-made content
segments.text: Meanwhile, regulators in Europe published new guidance on how companies must label content created by machines. If you publish online, this one affects you.

segments.headline: New open-source database claims ten times the traffic
segments.text: And finally, a new open-source database promises to handle ten times more traffic on the same hardware. Early tests look promising, but real-world results will tell the full story.
That's the brief. Thanks for listening, and I'll see you tomorrow.
